question: Which saturated salt solution set the humidity at which single crystals were most frequent?
expect: sodium bromide: single crystals become more frequent at RH about 59%, which saturated NaBr maintained (LiCl 11%, MgCl2 33%) (Experimental Setup; Results)
rendered: According to the document, at higher relative humidity (RH ≈ 59%), the fraction of single-crystal deposits increases, indicating that slower evaporation favors crystal growth within the droplet. The saturated solution used to maintain the relative humidity at 59% was sodium bromide.
